title: Uchinchi shaxs: he, she, it
can_do: Boshqa odam haqida he/she/it bilan gapirasaniz
why: O'zbek tilida uchinchi shaxs — u, u (mashhur), u. Ingliz tilida esa uchinchi shaxs uchun alohida shakllar bo'lib, ularni to'g'ri tanlash kerak: he — og'a, she — ayol, it — jonli va narsa, tug'un.

rule.title: Inglizcha uchinchi shaxs — he, she, it

points.text: Ingliz tilida uchinchi shaxs ketma-ketligi: he — og'a, she — ayol, it — hech qanday narsani anglatishi mumkin (narsa yoki jonli). O'zbek tilida esa shu yerda emas.

examples.en: He is my brother. — U menga akam.
examples.uz: He is my brother. — U menga akam.

examples.en: She is my sister. — U menga opam.
examples.uz: She is my sister. — U menga opam.

examples.en: It is a dog. — U — bu it.
examples.uz: It is a dog. — U — bu it.

points.text: It — yo'qotib qolgan shaxs, masalan, it — it. Bundan keyin, it bilan bog'liq har bir so'z ingliz tilida it bilan qo'llaniladi.

examples.en: It is my key. — Bu menga kalit.
examples.uz: It is my key. — Bu menga kalit.

points.text: O'zbek tilida uchinchi shaxs uchun bir shaxslar ketma-ketligi: men och, u — och uchun. Bundan keyin, uchinchi shaxs ingliz tilida uchinchi shaxs uchun bo'lyapti har bir so'z kaynar.

examples.en: I see him. — Men uni ko'raman.
examples.uz: I see him. — Men uni ko'raman.

examples.en: I see him. — Men uni ko'raman.
examples.uz: I see him. — Men uni ko'raman.

points.text: O'zbek tilida uchinchi shaxs biror narsa haqida gapirishda ishlatiladi: I — it. Bundan keyin, uchinchi shaxs biror narsa haqida gapirishda ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I — it shaxs uchun inglizcha shaxs uchun — shunday.
examples.uz: I — it shaxs uchun inglizcha shaxs uchun — shunday.

common_errors.wrong: I — uchinchi shaxs — ingliz tilida uchinchi shaxs — inglizcha
common_errors.right: Uchinchi shaxs — he/she/it — ingliz tilida inglizcha shaxs uchun
common_errors.why: Uchinchi shaxs — uchinchi shaxs — ingliz tilida inglizcha shaxs uchun

common_errors.wrong: Shaxs — inglizcha shaxs ucennik shaxsi — uchinchi shaxs — ingliz tili
common_errors.right: Uchinchi shaxs — ingliz tilida uchinchi shaxs — uchinchi shaxs uchun
common_errors.why: Uchinchi shaxs — ingliz tilida shudda shaxs uchun shu yosh o'zbek tillarida
